name: Cloudflare
description: Internet-infrastructure brand system led by Cloudflare orange, taut grotesk typography, pale technical surfaces, slim borders, tiny radii, and diagrammatic product modules that make networking feel fast, precise, and industrial rather than soft SaaS.

name: Framer
description: Dark, product-led web-building identity with electric Framer Blue, tight Geist typography, pill actions, compact glassy nav, and screenshot-heavy modules that make publishing feel instant.

name: GitHub
description: Developer-native platform identity built from black-and-white GitHub brand contrast, Mona Sans typography, Primer UI density, green CTAs, blue product links, Octicon language, bordered cards, code surfaces, and contribution-grid patterns.

name: Next.js
description: Developer-first monochrome system with Geist typography, terminal-coded hero moments, hairline borders, pill controls, and a disciplined split between polished launch marketing and dense utility docs.

name: OpenAI
description: Dark, editorial AI brand system with OpenAI Sans, image-first modular news cards, quiet pill actions, flat translucent surfaces, and precise negative-tracked typography.

name: Raycast
description: Dark, command-palette-native productivity identity with red action accents, glossy inset panels, precise 8px rhythm, huge cinematic serif hero type, and macOS-like utility surfaces.

name: Amazon Commerce System
description: Functional, conversion-oriented marketplace design with a dark utility header, dominant search bar, light-grey commerce canvas, and modular product/category areas.

name: IKEA Global
description: Editorial IKEA global design system: democratic living, bold blue/yellow, flat magazine grid, large lifestyle image cards, and friendly Noto IKEA typography.

name: Nike.com Retail Editorial
description: Monochrome, image-led performance commerce system with Nike Futura display, Helvetica Now utility typography, full-bleed campaign modules and flat product grids.

name: Discord
description: Playful communication brand built on Blurple, oversized ABC Ginto hero headlines, gg sans utility text, pill CTAs, dark utility surfaces, and illustrated mega-navs that make product marketing feel like a game world.

name: Disney+
description: Cinematic streaming system built from midnight navy-black stages, crisp Inspire typography, cyan-teal action sparks, poster-led rails, bundle comparison modules, and a distinct shift into lighter Salesforce-style help surfaces.

name: Medium
description: Editorial publishing system for reading, writing, membership and story discovery. Extracted from the public Medium homepage via Jina text snapshot and the live hero artwork asset; direct browser rendering was blocked by Cloudflare.

name: Netflix
description: Cinematic subscription product system built around black stages, assertive Netflix red actions, dense poster-led rows, heavy sans headlines, and a split between immersive entertainment marketing and crisp utility account flows.

name: Brex
description: Precise intelligent-finance system with Brex orange actions, tight Inter typography, white modular product cards, muted enterprise neutrals, and screenshot-led finance workflows.

name: Coinbase
description: An institutional-grade crypto exchange whose marketing surfaces read like a quietly-confident financial-services brand. The base canvas is pure white; Coinbase Blue (`#0052ff`) is the single brand voltage, used scarcely on primary CTAs, signature glyphs, and inline accent moments. Type runs Coinbase's licensed CoinbaseDisplay (display) and CoinbaseSans (body) at modest weights — display sits at weight 400 not 700, signaling editorial calm rather than fintech-bombastic. Page rhythm rotates between bright white sections, soft gray elevation bands, and full-bleed dark editorial heroes (`#0a0b0d`) carrying product-ui mockup cards. Iconography is geometric and minimal; depth comes from card-on-card layering, never decorative shadows.

name: Mastercard
description: Warm editorial magazine aesthetic built from soft stone and signal orange, extreme stadium pill border radiuses, circular orbit imagery, and MarkForMC typography.

name: PayPal
description: Trust-first payments identity with assertive PayPal blues, black-and-white clarity, pill-shaped commerce CTAs, compact geometric typography, and modular pay, send, save, checkout, and pricing patterns.

name: Stripe
description: Precision financial-infrastructure identity with violet action color, deep navy ink, angled Stripe geometry, product UI mockups, fine dashed dividers, and dense developer-first modules.

name: Wise
description: Transparent money-product system built around vivid Wise Green, deep forest text, pill navigation, compact currency calculators, flag-led selectors, and flat rounded utility surfaces.

name: Duolingo
description: Playful, gamified learning system with Duo Green, rounded brand fonts, 3D cartoon illustrations, button bottom-edges, and a modular feature rhythm.

name: Apple
description: A photography-first interface that turns marketing into a museum gallery. Edge-to-edge product tiles alternate light and dark canvases, framed by SF Pro Display headlines with negative letter-spacing and a single Action Blue (#0066cc) interactive color. UI chrome recedes so the product can speak — no decorative gradients, no shadows on chrome, only the one signature drop-shadow under product imagery resting on a surface.

name: Pinterest
description: Image-centred discovery system with Pinterest Red as a strictly reserved CTA accent, Pin Sans, soft 16px radius, and masonry-style pin cards.

name: Mailchimp
description: Warm editorial marketing system with Cavendish Yellow action surfaces, Peppercorn ink, Means Web headlines, Graphik UI, tactile pill CTAs, and flat pricing/product tables.

name: Arc
description: Calm future-browser identity with warm off-white canvases, charcoal editorial type, coral pill actions, oversized product screenshots, soft app-like panels, and privacy-first conversational copy.

name: ClickUp
description: Dense AI-work SaaS identity with ink-black CTAs, ClickUp's four-color gradient logo system, rounded modular app cards, mono product labels, and a high-volume 'everything app' feature rhythm.

name: Notion
description: Current Notion marketing and product design: dark AI night-shift hero, light modular workspace sections, NotionInter/Lyon Text, blue CTA roles, colourful agent and product cards, flat document-like components.

name: Slack
description: Conversational AI work-platform identity built from aubergine action color, Salesforce-derived headline typography, dense rounded product UI screenshots, bento feature modules, and a warm off-white editorial rhythm.

name: Strawberry
description: Warm off-white AI-browser identity with custom Strawberry type, ink-black pill actions, coral micro-markers, rounded cream panels, animated companions, and chat-like browser automation modules.

name: Vodafone
description: High-contrast telecom identity built around Vodafone Red, oversized condensed-feeling brand typography, pill CTAs, flat editorial cards, video-led heroes, and repeated connected-world content modules.

name: Booking.com
description: Booking.com homepage: high-conversion travel commerce system with full-bleed brand blue, a yellow search frame, modular property cards, destination image cards, review badges, Genius promos, and dense link/footer ecosystems.

name: Tripadvisor
description: Travel marketplace system with deep Trip Green ink, neon Trip Brand search actions, pill-shaped controls, dense photo-led recommendation cards, rating bubbles, and flat editorial discovery rails.
